content: Standard technique for grounding LLM extraction to prevent hallucinated quotes: require model to output the exact quoted substring alongside each claim, then verify server-side with a two-tier check: (1) exact O(n) substring search against source text, (2) fallback whitespace-normalized (collapse whitespace, strip leading/trailing, tolerate punctuation/ellipsis differences) case-insensitive substring search. Reject/flag any claim whose quote fails both tiers. This is the dominant pattern across recent extraction-verification literature (arXiv 2607.03325, 2601.00821, biorxiv token-alignment paper) and maps directly onto verifying evidence_quotes against epub prose text + word_position.
